title: Tuesday Night Meditation and Dharma Teaching                                                          (We have moved to NEST RALEIGH)
location_address: 414 Fayetteville St Ave, Raleigh 4th floor (email or text for door code)
description:
Please note - we are no longer at GreenDoor Vitality, which closed in August. We have been lucky enough to find a new space!. 
We now meet every Tuesday evening at NEST CO-WORKING SPACE,
414 Fayetteville Street - 4th floor.  For the door code send an email to info@sitraleigh.com or text me at 919-306-9495. (if you already have the code it stays the same)

For our teaching this Tuesday,  9/29, we begin a deeper unpacking of the Noble Eightfold Path. This week's topic are the Wisdom Factors of Wise View and Wise Intention. We begin with a 25-30 minute meditation and finish with the Dharma talk. All are welcome. Class by Dana (generosity). 
Parking is free after 6pm on the street (in legal spaces) in downtown Raleigh. We are also on Zoom if you cannot make it in person. (link below)
